baseline_snapshot.integrity: Runtime files are read-only and content hashes are checked before and after measurement.

candidate_snapshot.integrity: Runtime files are read-only and content hashes are checked before and after measurement.

method.build: maturin build --release --locked; install immutable wheels in minimal virtual environments
method.ordering: Seeded permutation blocks; every six rounds use all six package orders once for each measurement boundary
method.runtime_boundary: identical Python constructors, parser.parse_args, Command.main and get_help
method.speedup_definition: Reference median / candidate median; >1 is faster. Paired raw round ratios are also retained.
method.memory_scope: tracemalloc: Python allocations only; RSS: per-worker whole-process high-water mark. Scalars are medians across rounds.
method.isolation: Fresh -I worker per variant and round; fresh -I interpreter per cold sample; no runtime imports from checkout
method.hash_seed: Interpreter-randomized in each isolated process; -I ignores PYTHONHASHSEED
method.frequency_control: Observed, not locked; optional affinity is recorded and inherited by children
method.limitations: Results are workload-specific. Shared-host activity, frequency, caches and GC affect timing. No universal speedup is claimed.
